headline: Colonials Strike Back in Mooring County as Wardens Seize Lathair
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, the quiet in Mooring County proved short-lived as Colonial forces mounted sharp counterattacks, reclaiming two strategic positions amid bitter fighting across MacConmara Barrows and The Cut. To the south, Linn of Mercy erupted into the day's bloodiest theater; Warden forces successfully captured the strategic settlement of Lathair, though at grievous cost, absorbing more than 1,800 casualties against 800 Colonial losses over the past two hours. The northern snowfields of Weathered Expanse remain an unrelenting furnace of attrition, where mutual casualties have exceeded three thousand men within two hours and three ruined bases lie contested between Wightwalk and Frostmarch. Marban Hollow has similarly reignited with five separate turnovers recorded around Checkpoint Bua, leaving two positions in no-man's-land. Along the western approaches of Nevish Line and Stonecradle, heavy rifle and artillery fire continues to accelerate without immediate shifts in ownership, whereas eastern stretches like Stlican Shelf and Godcrofts have largely settled into defensive lulls following earlier engagements.
